site.name: Mi La-Cai Noodle House
site.address: 961 S State St, Salt Lake City, UT 84111
site.description: Family-owned Vietnamese & Chinese restaurant serving Salt Lake City since 2003 — authentic flavors, generous portions, warm hospitality.

hero.subtitle: Chào mừng · 欢迎 · Welcome
hero.description: Family-owned Vietnamese & Chinese comfort food in the heart of Salt Lake City. Every bowl of pho, every crispy egg roll — crafted with tradition, served with warmth.

specials.name: Spicy Lemongrass Seafood Noodles
specials.desc: Shrimp, squid & mussels wok-tossed in aromatic lemongrass chili broth over chewy egg noodles.

specials.name: Honey Glazed Walnut Shrimp
specials.desc: Jumbo shrimp wok-fried in a honey glaze, topped with candied walnuts & toasted sesame.

specials.name: Buddha's Harvest Bowl
specials.desc: Seasonal vegetables, crispy tofu & jasmine rice tossed in a light ginger-soy glaze.

paragraphs: For over two decades, Mi La-Cai has been a cherished destination on State Street — bringing together Vietnam's bright, herbaceous flavors and the rich, satisfying warmth of Chinese comfort food.
Every bowl of pho is simmered for hours. Every egg roll is hand-rolled. Every dish reflects our commitment to authentic recipes, fresh ingredients, and genuine hospitality.

why_different.title: Fresh Daily
why_different.desc: We source the freshest herbs & ingredients every morning. Our broths simmer for 12+ hours — never from a packet.

why_different.title: Family Recipes
why_different.desc: Every dish follows traditional recipes passed down through generations. Taste the difference heritage makes.

why_different.title: Warm Hospitality
why_different.desc: We treat every guest like family. Our welcoming atmosphere has earned us 1,900+ glowing reviews over 23 years.

fun_facts.title: 12+ Hours
fun_facts.desc: Our pho broth simmers overnight for deep, complex flavor — never from a powder.

fun_facts.title: Hand-Rolled
fun_facts.desc: Every egg roll is individually wrapped by hand each morning, just like grandma taught us.

fun_facts.title: Fresh Herbs Daily
fun_facts.desc: We source Thai basil, mint & cilantro from local farms every single morning.

fun_facts.title: Secret Family Spice
fun_facts.desc: Our signature pho spice blend has been passed down through three generations.

dining_steps.title: Find Your Seat
dining_steps.desc: Walk in or call ahead — casual seating for families & friends.

dining_steps.title: Browse & Order
dining_steps.desc: Pick from 50+ dishes — dietary options clearly marked.

dining_steps.title: Savor & Enjoy
dining_steps.desc: Dig into generous portions — add sriracha & hoisin!

dining_steps.title: Come Back Soon
dining_steps.desc: Leave with a full belly — your favorite awaits next time.

testimonials.quote: Best pho in SLC hands down. The broth is incredibly rich — you can tell it's been simmering for hours. Egg rolls are perfectly crispy too!
testimonials.name: Sarah M.

testimonials.quote: The walnut shrimp is incredible — crispy, sweet, perfectly balanced. Great family atmosphere. We come every week!
testimonials.name: David L.

testimonials.quote: As someone gluten-free, finding good Asian food is tough — Mi La-Cai has so many options! Vegetable pho is my go-to.
testimonials.name: Emily R.

ways_to_dine.title: Dine-In
ways_to_dine.desc: Relax in our warm, casual atmosphere. Perfect for family dinners and catching up with friends.

ways_to_dine.title: Takeout
ways_to_dine.desc: Order ahead and pick up at the counter. All your favorites packed fresh and ready to go.

ways_to_dine.title: Curbside Pickup
ways_to_dine.desc: Call ahead and we'll bring your order to your car. Quick, convenient & contactless.

values.title: Our Mission
values.desc: To bring authentic Vietnamese & Chinese flavors to Salt Lake City — one bowl of pho and one smile at a time.

values.title: Our Vision
values.desc: To be Salt Lake City's most loved destination for Vietnamese & Chinese comfort food — where every guest feels at home.

values.title: Our Promise
values.desc: Fresh ingredients daily. Authentic family recipes. Warm, welcoming service. Every single time.

catering.title: Hosting an Event?
catering.description: We offer large takeout orders for gatherings, parties & office events. Let us bring authentic Vietnamese & Chinese flavors to your celebration.

final_cta.description: Open six days a week on State Street — lunch & dinner. Walk in or call ahead.
